subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Sun Oct 11 shortlist | thin week — 3 candidates (PROF, HAE, VST)
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Shortlist

Sunday, October 11, 2026 — Kuwait time

3 candidates cleared the gates

Thin week — 25+ raw candidates scanned, only 3 survived live-data confirmation. Best setup: PROF (Profound Medical), actionable now with no pullback wait.

⚠️ Thin day — honesty rule

This week's net came back mostly noise: stale screener pages, undated roundups, and generic commentary with no confirmable October 2026 tickers. Only 3 names had a fresh, dated catalyst that IBKR live data actually confirmed. Rather than pad to 5-10, this is the honest list — see "Cut this run" below for what got dropped and why.

25+ raw tickers surfaced across web search + IBKR topic discovery. 3 cleared all 4 gates (live signal, liquidity/sizing, halal + defense exclusion, extension check). Run stock-analyzer on any name for the full deep dive before entering.
#1 — PROF | Profound Medical Corp
⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5 Healthcare / Medtech SMALL CAP

Signal: Preliminary Q3 2026 revenue update (Oct 7) came in ~45-47% above Bloomberg consensus ($9.8-10.0M vs $6.78M), gross margin guided >70%. Stock gapped from $5.68 close to open $6.50 and closed +21.7% at $6.91 on Oct 8, volume 1.83M vs a normal ~100-200K (~10x average). Held the gain Oct 9 (closed $6.90, intraday high $7.25). 2 trading days fresh.

Price: $6.88 (IBKR live) | Avg daily $ vol: ~$0.6-0.9M normal days (thin — sized small on purpose) | RS vs SPY: wildly outperforming (+21% on the move vs a flat tape)

Why it's interesting: This is a fundamental beat, not a rumor — preliminary numbers from the company itself, confirmed by real volume, not a web-search narrative. The stock gave back almost none of the pop over the following session, which is the sign of a real repricing rather than a one-day spike that fades.

Realistic near-term target: +9-23% over 3-8 trading days — first target is the Oct 9 swing high ($7.50 round level just above it), stretch target is the 13-week high ($8.50) if the move keeps going into the Nov 5 full earnings print.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET / LIMIT NEAR CURRENT — only pulled back slightly from the post-pop high, not badly extended. No need to chase or wait.

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY limit $6.85 · stop-limit trigger $6.50 / limit $6.40 (just below the Oct 8 gap-open shelf — a close back under fills the gap and kills the thesis) · TP1 sell limit $7.50 · TP2 $8.50 · size 9 shares ≈ $61.65 (~14.3% of ~$430 available cash) · R:R ~1.6:1 to TP1, ~4.3:1 to TP2
Event window: Beat already behind it ✅ — full Q3 report Nov 5, time-stop before then
Halal: ✅ Verified — core business is MRI-guided medical devices (TULSA-PRO prostate/kidney ablation). Clean.
Defense/military check: ✅ Clear
Sizing note: thin average volume (~$0.6-0.9M/day) — use limit orders only, don't market-order size up. $2 round-trip commission is ~3.2% of this position; TP1 at +9% clears it comfortably.

Next step: analyze PROF
#2 — HAE | Haemonetics Corp
⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5 Healthcare / Medtech MID CAP

Signal: CSL Plasma announced a wider rollout of Haemonetics' plasma collection systems across 300+ US centers (Oct 8). Stock gapped from $101.71 close to open $115, closed +17.5% at $119.47, volume 1.72M vs normal ~150-200K (~8-10x average). Oct 9 pushed to a fresh 52-week intraday high ($121.20) before closing roughly flat at $118.69. 2 trading days fresh.

Price: $117.08 (IBKR live, pulling back intraday) | Avg daily $ vol: ~$15-20M normal days — highly liquid | RS vs SPY: strongly outperforming, sitting at its 52-week high

Why it's interesting: A confirmed commercial expansion (not a rumor), with two analyst price-target raises (BTIG to $130, Citi upgrade to Buy) layered on top. The catch: it's already AT its 52-week high after a 17%+ two-day move — this is the exact "correct thesis, chased entry" trap the finder is built to flag.

Realistic near-term target: +6-11% over 3-7 trading days from a pullback entry — first target is a retest of the current high ($121), stretch target $125 on a clean breakout.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $112-114 — chasing at the current high offers poor R:R; the gap-day low is the first real support to let the move digest against.

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY limit $113.00 · stop-limit trigger $111.50 / limit $110.00 (just below the Oct 8 gap-day low — a break back under fills the gap) · TP1 sell limit $121.00 · TP2 $125.00 · size 0.57 shares ≈ $64.41 (~15.0% of ~$430 available cash, requires fractional — confirm enabled before entering) · R:R ~5.3:1 to TP1
Event window: Catalyst already behind it ✅ — next earnings Nov 5, time-stop before then
Halal: ✅ Verified — core business is blood/plasma collection medical devices. Clean.
Defense/military check: ✅ Clear
Sizing note: requires fractional shares (0.57). Highly liquid — no exit constraint.

Next step: analyze HAE
#3 — VST | Vistra Corp
⭐⭐⭐ 3/5 Utilities / Power Generation LARGE CAP

Signal: US Dept. of Energy issued a conditional loan commitment of up to $4.2B (Oct 5, via its Office of Energy Dominance Financing — a civilian energy-infrastructure program, NOT defense) to upgrade Vistra's Beaver Valley, Davis-Besse and Perry nuclear plants for AI/data-center power demand. Stock popped +10.8% Oct 6 to $160.50, extended to $166.72 Oct 7 (high $168.11), then pulled back to $156.14 Oct 8 (low $155.21), recovering to $161.48 Oct 9. 3 trading days fresh — choppy, but intact.

Price: $161.02 (IBKR live) | Avg daily $ vol: ~$1B+/day — mega liquid | RS vs SPY: strongly outperforming, also riding the week's sector-rotation tailwind — utilities led all sector ETF inflows ($1.14B) for the week ending Oct 2

Why it's interesting: A confirmed, funded federal program (not a rumor) tied to the AI-power-demand theme, on a name with essentially unlimited liquidity for this account size. The catch: it's whipsawed hard in 3 sessions (high $168 → low $155 → back to $161), so chasing the current price buys into the middle of that range with mediocre R:R.

Realistic near-term target: +4-8% over 3-7 trading days from a pullback entry — first target is a retest of the post-announcement high ($168), stretch target the 13-week high ($169.72).

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $155-157 — the zone that held as support through the Oct 8 pullback. Chasing at $161 gives roughly 1:1 R:R; from the pullback zone it's closer to 6:1.

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY limit $156.00 · stop-limit trigger $154.00 / limit $152.50 (below the Oct 7 low, which held through the pullback) · TP1 sell limit $168.00 · TP2 $169.72 · size 0.41 shares ≈ $63.96 (~14.9% of ~$430 available cash, requires fractional — confirm enabled before entering) · R:R ~6:1 to TP1 from the pullback entry (don't chase at $161 — R:R there is ~1:1)
Event window: Catalyst already behind it ✅ — next earnings Nov 6, time-stop before then
Halal: ✅ Verified — core business is electricity generation and retail (gas/nuclear/renewables). Not banking/insurance. Clean.
Defense/military check: ✅ Clear — DOE's Office of Energy Dominance Financing is a civilian energy-infrastructure loan program, explicitly distinct from the Dept. of War loan that got WOLF excluded below.
Sizing note: requires fractional shares (0.41). Mega liquid — no exit constraint.

Next step: analyze VST

🏆 Today's best setup

PROF — Profound Medical Corp

It's the only one of the three that doesn't need you to wait. The catalyst is a company-issued preliminary revenue beat (not a loan headline or a partnership press release), confirmed by a 10x volume spike, and the stock has held the move for a full session without giving it back — the signature of a real repricing, not a one-day pop. HAE and VST both have real theses but are sitting extended at highs after sharp 2-3 day moves; PROF is the one you can act on today without chasing.

Invalidation: a close back below $6.50 (the Oct 8 gap-open level) — that fills the gap and says the breakout thesis is wrong. That's the stop reference, not a percentage guess.

Cut this run — showing the work

WOLF (Wolfspeed) — excluded, hard rule: $1.5B conditional loan is explicitly from the Dept. of War's Office of Strategic Capital for "critical national security applications" — a defense-financing catalyst, same exclusion category as a DoD contract award, regardless of Wolfspeed not being a defense prime.
BSP (Bending Spoons) — dropped, stale/unclear signal: +24% on Oct 7 with no confirmed catalyst found anywhere, on a stock that only IPO'd this summer. Can't pass Gate 1 on a search narrative alone with zero fundamental backing.
CRWV (CoreWeave) — dropped, FADED vs live data: web search returned AI-momentum commentary, but the most recent confirmable price point (Oct 5) showed the stock down 2.5% with no October rally substantiated anywhere.
Option Care Health (OPCH) — dropped, wrong trade type: +32.7% was a $5.8B acquisition announcement, not momentum — that's merger arbitrage (price converges to deal terms, limited further upside, different risk profile), outside this skill's "fast in-and-out" mandate.
Apimeds Pharmaceuticals, SDEV — dropped, illiquid/pump pattern: +52.7% and +402% moves respectively on thin narratives ("blockchain contract," stablecoin platform); SDEV's own source flagged it as a "pump and fade trap."
PACB, QSI — dropped, stale: partnership news from the week of Sep 28-Oct 2, now more than 5 trading days old.
PENG (Penguin Solutions) — dropped, unconfirmable: conflicting earnings-date data and no verifiable October catalyst, on a stock already +143% YTD (badly extended even if a catalyst existed).
DVN / APA / COP (oil majors) — dropped, undated: a crude-oil-driven rally was reported but the source date couldn't be pinned to this month with confidence.

Cap-size mix this run: 1 small cap (PROF), 1 mid cap (HAE), 1 large cap (VST) — not skewed to one side.

How to use this

This shortlist alone is not enough to enter a trade. Pick 1-2 that feel interesting, run analyze [TICKER] for the full fundamentals/event-risk/stop-limit deep dive, then size to leave room for 5-7 concurrent positions. Log any entry with portfolio-manager.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Sizing uses ~$430 available cash (most recent IBKR-confirmed read; SPXC reconciliation still pending in portfolio.json — run portfolio-manager to sync before placing size-sensitive orders). Verify halal compliance quarterly on Zoya or Musaffa. Generated Sunday, October 11, 2026, Kuwait time.
